segments.he: דְּתַנְיָא: אָכַל דְּבֵילָה קְעִילִית, וְשָׁתָה דְּבַשׁ וְחָלָב, וְנִכְנַס לַמִּקְדָּשׁ –
segments.en: From where is it learned that honey and milk are intoxicating? «As it is taught» in a baraita: If a priest «ate» pressed «figs from Ke’ila, or drank honey or milk,» thereby becoming intoxicated, «and he» then «entered the Temple» to perform the Temple service,
he is «liable» for entering the Temple while intoxicated.

moves.about: a priest who ate Ke'ila figs or drank honey/milk and entered the Temple is liable — they intoxicate
